There is more to Louisiana than just New Orleans. You made no mention of life in north Louisiana.  Nor central Louisiana.  Lake Charles was never mentioned. Shame on you. Understand this: New Orleans hardly recognize Cajun foods or even that we existed, until Paul Produmne made Cajun food popular nationwide.  Suddenly all of New Orleans was "CAJUN".  Give me a break.  North Louisiana 
has historic sites that dates back thousands of years to the indigenous people of Louisiana....no mention. 
I do not recommend this documentary unless you want information on NewOrleans.
